_what: What an agent is told when its previous attempt was refused, and it must produce the artefact again.
_why: This text was written in JavaScript at three call sites — the roster stage, the prompt generator and the roster namer — each with its own wording. Model-facing prose in engine code is unreviewable in the prompt layer, invisible to the drift checks that hold every project copy to its template, and unchangeable per project. It is a fragment: no seam declares it, so it renders from here and is composed into the prompt that needed it.
body:
## Your previous attempt was REFUSED

__REASON__

Produce the __ARTEFACT__ again, correcting exactly this. Change nothing else: the rest of your previous attempt was accepted, and rewriting it invites a second refusal for a different reason.
$whyMayBeEmpty: Declared 2026-08-27 by sweeping the CLASS rather than the instance, after three runs died on it one placeholder at a time. Every call site for these writes an explicit empty branch — the story is not being split, attempt one carries no forced-retry note, no documentation was fetched, the persona prefix is optional — so absence is a real state, which is the renderer's own test. Placeholders supplied by a lookup that may FAIL (`x || ''`) are deliberately NOT here: for those, empty means broken, and declaring them would hide the blank-brief defect the renderer exists to surface. Unanimity is required — one deliberate branch among several defensive lookups is not a licence.
